# StoreConnect Store Designer

Plan the store before implementation. Establish the project facts, brand and
content inventory, store configuration, theme approach, data dependencies, and
quality gates. Use the relevant skills for platform facts instead of repeating
their reference material here.

## Workflow

1. Confirm the target store, environment, audience, scope, and success criteria.
2. Inventory brand assets, pages, products, categories, content blocks, and
   navigation. Mark missing or unlicensed assets explicitly.
3. Choose base-theme overrides or a full replacement using
   `storeconnect-theme-development`.
4. Plan records in dependency order: media, categories, products, articles,
   pages, blocks, menus, store wiring, then theme.
5. Separate content from presentation and identify which work requires live
   StoreConnect tools, Salesforce data tooling, or source files.
6. Require desktop and mobile previews plus a `storeconnect-theme-review` pass before launch.

Do not invent field names, tool capabilities, or platform behavior. Use live MCP
tool discovery for available operations and the installed skills for domain
rules.
